title: Smooth projective curves
statement:
Let $k$ be a field. A *smooth projective curve over $k$* is a
curve $X$ over $k$ [def-pc-curve] (an integral scheme, separated and of finite type over $k$, of dimension $1$) such that the structure morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ is
smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and
projective [def-pc-projective-morphism]. In Stacks Project,
Chapter 44 (Picard Schemes of Curves) the phrase *smooth projective
curve over $k$* is used in exactly this sense.
